ranking.note: Raised to P2: this is the only PR that corrects factually wrong documentation (claiming any SAM v3.1 router works) which leads users into failed configurations — the category's top criterion.
Raised to P2 to sit with other documentation that prevents operator misconfiguration; privacy/broadcast-scope guidance has security consequences if absent, unlike the clarity-only P3 items.

inconsistencies: #35518 and #35480 are by the same author and both close parts of issue #14278 (notification-semantics documentation); they overlap in audience and framing — review #35518 first, since it sets the general async/no-ordering model that the ZMQ-specific #35480 builds on.

#36704 and #36782 are both codebase-wide comment cleanups by the same author touching overlapping files; reviewing them together (and merging #36704's lint gate last) avoids rebase churn, but neither has a priority claim over the other.

#36101 is the only PR whose value is leverage over other open work (#34931 and recurring validation/I/O review debates); its disputed approach does not lower its priority, but it is the one item here whose delay keeps other PRs stalled.

#35858 partially overlaps #36829: both touch I2P/privacy operator guidance (doc/i2p.md). #35858 moves unlinkability text out of doc/i2p.md while #36829 edits that same file's router-version claims — merge order matters to avoid losing the version fix.
result.notes: The list is thin at the top: only one wrong-documentation fix (#36829) and two leverage/misconfiguration documents justify P2. The remaining spread is genuine — missing-docs items (#35518, #35480, #32278), release-note hygiene (#36773), and pure comment-syntax cleanups (#36704, #36782, #30361) — so the bands were kept distinct rather than compressed.
